answer_1.quote: We consider large Transformer-based architectures trained on dialogue tasks... We collect a dataset of 5k conversations yielding around 70k total utterances to evaluate the safety of several generative models.

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluations are provided in Appendix D. We report perplexity (PPL) and F1 scores, as well as the safety classifier fire rate on model generations.

answer_4.quote: We use the ACUTE‑eval method of evaluating conversational quality... crowdworkers are presented with two conversations and asked 'Who would you prefer to talk to for a long conversation?'. We also conduct human safety evaluations where annotators label responses as safe or unsafe.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare pairwise conversations and answer which model is more engaging, and rate the safety/offensiveness of each model's response.
